instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Phase 4 synthesis and quarterly warning-board recommendation
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Reliance on a long track record of stability to justify sustained low vigilance and forgone verification effort while synthesizing newly converging multi-INT indicators, instead of treating convergence as a trigger for renewed scrutiny.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Anchoring bias is a related but distinct construct. The RAG describes the stability history as an anchor and insufficient adjustment, but this is not an established alias for Complacency Bias.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The RAG correctly locates the final synthesis, says the stable history carried disproportionate weight after all three indicators were visible, and connects that weight to unchanged confidence and verification effort. This captures the hidden instance's mechanism even though the label differs.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The cited interview quotations are present and attributed to the participant. The clearest quote is the statement that the history of stability was the anchor point for the recommendation.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The finding focuses on selective interpretation and evidence search across the Phase 1–3 setup decisions. Those decisions are explicitly outside the one planned instance, which occurs at the Phase 4 synthesis. Its strongest mapped evidence is in a negative segment, so it is a false positive in both instance scorecards.

The quote and mechanism match the hidden synthesis episode, but Anchoring Bias is not an approved equivalent of the target Complacency Bias label. It is therefore a strict false positive and leaves the hidden target as a strict false negative; it is a mechanism-first true positive.

high_only.detection_interpretation: The high-confidence confirmation-bias finding localizes to a negative setup segment. Neither positive Phase 4 segment is detected at this threshold.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: There are no moderate-confidence findings, so results are unchanged from high_only.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Adding the low-confidence anchoring finding detects seg_013, while seg_012 remains a miss under the one-best-segment localization rule; the confirmation-bias finding remains a false alarm.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: There are no candidates, so results are unchanged from all_identified_confidence_levels.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: The finding shares the broad outcome of preserving the existing assessment, but emphasizes selective interpretation and evidence search across Phases 1–3 rather than reduced vigilance at the final synthesis.
The location and full mechanism match the final synthesis instance, but anchoring is a distinct construct from the hidden target label.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the RAG misses both positive segments and produces one false alarm on a negative setup segment.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: No strict true positive at any threshold. The low-confidence anchoring finding has the right location and full mechanism but the wrong target label; the high-confidence confirmation-bias finding is outside the scored instance.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At all_identified_confidence_levels, the low-confidence anchoring finding matches the target instance's location and full mechanism, yielding one true positive, one false positive, and one false alarm.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: No candidate findings were supplied, so the candidate tier has no effect on the scores.
main_failure_modes: The high-confidence confirmation-bias finding generalizes the Phase 1–3 setup decisions into a scored bias despite the hidden specification limiting the target occurrence to Phase 4.
The actual Phase 4 occurrence is labeled anchoring bias rather than Complacency Bias, preventing a strict match.
Both positive frozen segments represent the same occurrence; under the one-best-segment localization rule, seg_012 remains undetected when obs_002 is localized to seg_013.
main_strengths: The low-confidence anchoring finding uses valid participant quotations and identifies the final synthesis episode.
Its mechanism description captures the stability history's influence on confidence and verification effort after the indicators were considered together.
The analysis avoids using the later reporting as proof that the original judgment was biased.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the run does not detect the hidden instance. Including low-confidence findings recovers the instance under the mechanism-first scorecard, while strict label-plus-mechanism scoring remains at zero because the RAG uses a near-neighbor label. The high-confidence finding on Phase 1–3 is an unsupported false positive under the frozen manifest.
